answer.question: What is finance SEO?
answer.text: Finance SEO is the process of improving the search visibility of financial companies, such as fintechs, advisors, lenders and accounting firms, so they attract qualified clients. Because financial content affects people's money, it requires strong expertise, accuracy, trust signals and compliance-reviewed content.

why.title: Why is finance SEO so demanding?

cards.title: "Your Money or Your Life" content
cards.text: Google applies its strictest quality standards to financial topics. Expertise and trust must be clear.

cards.title: Heavy competition
cards.text: Banks, publishers and comparison sites dominate many financial searches.

cards.title: Compliance requirements
cards.text: Financial marketing is regulated, so content often needs review before publishing.

cards.title: Trust drives conversion
cards.text: Visitors need to trust you before sharing financial details or booking a call.

cards.title: Service & product pages
cards.text: Clear, accurate pages for each financial product or service.

cards.title: Expert content
cards.text: Educational content written with, or reviewed by, qualified professionals.

cards.title: Author & reviewer credentials
cards.text: Visible qualifications on every piece of content.

cards.title: Trust signals
cards.text: Security, regulation details, reviews and clear company information.

cards.title: Technical SEO
cards.text: Speed, security, structured data and app/web structure for fintechs.

cards.title: Local SEO

ai.title: How do AI tools answer financial questions?
ai.text: People ask AI tools things like "What's the best budgeting app?" or "Do I need a financial advisor?" AI tools lean heavily on trusted, authoritative financial sources.
prompts: Do I need a financial advisor?

callout.title: Compliance note
callout.text: We write content to be accurate and balanced, and we build in time for your compliance team to review it. We don't make performance promises or claims your regulator wouldn't allow.

items.question: Can SEO work in a regulated industry?
items.answer: Yes. It just needs a careful process: accurate content, expert review and a compliance check before publishing.

items.question: How long does finance SEO take?
items.answer: Finance is competitive. Technical and local improvements can help within months, while competitive national rankings often take 6–12 months or more.

items.question: Do you work with fintech startups?
items.answer: Yes. We help fintechs with product pages, comparison content, technical SEO and AI visibility.

items.question: Do you work with accountants and financial advisors?
items.answer: Yes. Local SEO, service pages and expert content work well for advisory and accounting firms.

items.question: Who reviews financial content?
items.answer: Your qualified team members or compliance function should review all content. We build that step into the process.
